# Florida FR44 Auto Insurance

> Florida FR44 Auto Insurance helps drivers across Florida get fast, affordable FR44, SR22, DUI, and standard auto insurance quotes by comparing multiple licensed carriers, including Allstate and National General. Texting is the fastest way to reach the team.

Florida FR44 Auto Insurance is an independent insurance agency led by licensed Allstate agent Matt Saffian (Florida Resident License #G273626), not an insurance carrier itself. The agency compares rates across multiple Florida-licensed carriers — including Allstate and National General, an Allstate company — to find affordable coverage for drivers with FR44 or SR22 requirements, DUI convictions, high-risk driving records, no prior insurance, or no driving experience. The site is text-first: most customer contact happens by SMS rather than phone calls or in-person visits.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/): Overview of services, statewide Florida coverage, and quote request.
- [Get a Free Quote](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/quote/): Request a free FR44, SR22, or standard auto insurance quote.
- [FR44 Insurance](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/fr44-insurance/): Comprehensive overview of FR44 insurance in Florida.
- [SR22 Insurance](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/sr22-insurance/): Explanation of SR22 requirements and how they differ from FR44.
- [Florida Auto Insurance](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/florida-auto-insurance/): Breakdown of Florida auto insurance coverage types.
- [Guides](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/guides/): 18 long-form pillar guides on FR44, SR22, DUI, high-risk insurance, and more.
- [Blog](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/blog/): 89+ searchable, filterable articles across six categories (see below).
- [FAQ](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/faq/): 30+ frequently asked questions about FR44, SR22, and working with the agency.
- [About](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/about/): Agency mission, agent bio, and carrier affiliations.
- [Contact](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/contact/): Text, email, and service area — no phone-only support.

## Blog (searchable and filterable by category)

The blog at /blog/ includes a search bar and category filter pills. Categories:

- **FR44 Basics** — how FR44 works, filing process, requirements, certificates, coverage limits, quotes
- **SR22 Basics** — how SR22 works, filing process, requirements, certificates, coverage limits, quotes, payment plans
- **DUI Insurance** — coverage after first/second/multiple DUIs, finding carriers, affordability
- **Cost & Rates** — lowering premiums, discounts, comparing quotes, payment plans, credit score questions
- **Policies** — no prior insurance, no driving experience/history, license suspension/revocation, lapses, denied-coverage troubleshooting, non-owner insurance, choosing an agent
- **Florida Auto Insurance** — general Florida coverage requirements and driving laws

City-specific FR44/SR22 coverage pages exist for Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Melbourne, Port St. Lucie, Vero Beach, and Palm Bay.
